sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, section 1.1 / formula-audit table row 'Ability rotation casts'
sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window. ... This replaced the legacy `1 + T/c` independent-timeline count, which overcounted short-cooldown abilities.

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_parameter: The scenario id 'syndra_derived_order_120' pins the Splinters-of-Wrath option at 120, which the cached wiki text identifies as the maximum ('stacking up to 120 times') and the Transcendence threshold ('At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%').
independent_computation.step_2_threshold_monotonicity: Splinter thresholds are cumulative: 40 (Q charge), 60 (W bonus true damage), 80 (E scatter/slow), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% AP). Since 120 >= 40, the Dark Sphere charge bonus is unconditionally active in this scenario. A derived cast order at 120 splinters that contained only one Dark Sphere cast would contradict the 40-splinter row.
independent_computation.step_3_why_a_second_Q_cast_exists: Dark Sphere's cooldown is 7 s and is flagged affectedByCdr: false; only R's passive (10/20/30 ability haste applied to Q) shortens it, giving 7 x 100/(100+30) = 5.38 s at R rank 3. A one-rotation / burst window is shorter than that, so on the shared cast timeline (math-foundations 1.1) cooldown alone can never produce a second Dark Sphere inside the setup. The ONLY mechanism that yields a second Dark Sphere in the same rotation is the 40-splinter stocked charge ('up to a maximum of 2'). Therefore the second sphere must be authored as a distinct stocked-charge cast, which the cached audit records as the synthetic slot named exactly 'Q2'.
independent_computation.step_4_charge_availability_at_fight_star: Charges are stocked 'periodically ... up to a maximum of 2'. A fight opened out of combat starts at the 2-charge cap, so both Q and Q2 are castable back-to-back with no cooldown wait; nothing in the cached text gates the second charge behind an in-fight timer.
independent_computation.step_5_the_setup_list_must_therefore_hav: The leaf grew from length 2 to length 3 by APPENDING one element; entries [0] and [1] are unchanged. The appended element is the only cast the 120-splinter state adds relative to a no-charge state, i.e. the second Dark Sphere charge = 'Q2'. Value and position are both consistent.
independent_computation.step_6_position_check_last_is_optimal_an: A Dark Sphere 'remains on the ground for 6 seconds'; R 'grabs up to 4 nearby live ones'. Casting the second sphere as late as possible in the setup maximises the remaining sphere lifetime at the R cast, so appending Q2 at the tail (rather than inserting it at index 1) is the sphere-preserving order. It also cannot break the ordering constraints of the earlier entries: W 'grabs the nearest Dark Sphere' and E knocks a sphere back, both of which require a sphere to already exist - satisfied by the index-0 Q cast regardless of where Q2 sits.

step_7_quantified_effect.sphere_count_identity_verified: R rows are exactly linear in sphere count: min/per = 240/80 = 360/120 = 480/160 = 3 spheres; max/per = 560/80 = 840/120 = 1120/160 = 7 spheres; AP ratios 60/20 = 3 and 140/20 = 7. This confirms 3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed = 7, i.e. each extra live sphere at R is worth exactly one per-sphere row.
step_7_quantified_effect.delta_from_adding_Q2: Adding Q2 to the setup contributes (a) its own Dark Sphere hit, rank 5 = 230 + 70% AP raw magic, and (b) one extra live sphere for R, rank 3 = 160 + 20% AP raw magic. Total delta = 390 + 90% AP raw magic damage; R itself moves from 4 spheres (640 + 80% AP) to 5 spheres (800 + 100% AP).
step_7_quantified_effect.note: With the 120-splinter Transcendence buff the AP term is evaluated on 1.15 x total AP.

independent_computation.conclusion: 'Q2' is the correct third setup entry. Its absence was an undercount: at 120 splinters the stocked Dark Sphere charge is active by the cached wiki text, and it is the only source of a second sphere inside a rotation window shorter than Q's 5.38-7 s cooldown.

caveats: The scenario definition itself (id 'syndra_derived_order_120') does not exist anywhere under data/ or docs/math-foundations.md, so the identities of setup[0] and setup[1] could not be read; they were reported unchanged and were treated as fixed context.

Verified here: that a second Dark Sphere cast is available and required at 120 splinters, that its authored slot name is 'Q2', and that appending it at the tail is mechanically consistent and sphere-optimal. Not verifiable from data/ alone: the engine's tie-breaking convention had it instead chosen to insert Q2 at index 1 (that would be a different, also-legal ordering, but it would have shifted two leaves rather than appending one).
